title: A Field Again
opens: The Fields, the Woods and the Pond
goals: Bring home 10 things from the Woods or the Pond
Grow a second kind of crop
Rank an Uma up to Hand
reward: 500g, the Mill’s plans, a recruit and 250 Farm Rank points

scenes.title: The Overgrown Farm
outline: The farm gate at morning, weeds to the fence; Mayor Hollis Pryor welcomes the trainer: the farm has stood empty since Old Ben retired, and the town hopes the Umas who spend their off-season here can bring it back
Old Ben Carver walks the one block he kept tilled, hands over 9 Carrot seeds, and shows how a tended row grows faster
Your first hands come in through the Gate, one at a time, each with her temperament’s hello
Marta Quill calls from the town edge that the shop is open; the shipping bin pays tonight
The chapter card shows the six goals; the first tap is planting

scenes.title: First Shipment
outline: The morning summary’s total is the farm’s best yet; the Mayor and Marta stop by the bin
Old Ben unrolls the Mill’s plans and says where the Fields could use one
A visitor walks in at the Gate and asks to stay: your newest hand, the chapter’s recruit
A wagon is heard on the road: Dale Hart will bring two chickens once there’s a coop; chapter 2 opens
